threatImpacts.name: Initial Access
threatImpacts.description: Methods used by threat actors to gain initial access to a cloud environment, typically through credential theft or authentication bypass

threatImpacts.name: Malicious Code Execution
threatImpacts.description: Execution of threat actor-controlled code on cloud resources or services

threatImpacts.name: Persistence Establishment
threatImpacts.description: Techniques used by threat actors to maintain access to cloud environments across restarts, credential changes, or other interruptions

threatImpacts.name: Privilege Escalation
threatImpacts.description: Actions that allow a threat actor to gain a higher level of permissions or access than initially granted, expanding the actions they can perform

threatImpacts.name: Defense Evasion
threatImpacts.description: Techniques used by threat actors to avoid detection and circumvent security controls, including disabling logging or operating in unmonitored environments

threatImpacts.name: Credential Theft
threatImpacts.description: Techniques for stealing credentials such as access keys, passwords, tokens, or certificates that grant access to cloud resources

threatImpacts.name: Account and Resource Discovery
threatImpacts.description: Techniques used to discover information about cloud accounts, resources, permissions, and network topology

threatImpacts.name: Lateral Movement
threatImpacts.description: Techniques that enable threat actors to move through a cloud environment from one resource to another

threatImpacts.name: Data Collection
threatImpacts.description: Techniques used to identify and gather data of interest from cloud resources before exfiltration

threatImpacts.name: Data Exfiltration
threatImpacts.description: Unauthorized transfer of data from an organization's cloud resources to external locations controlled by a threat actor

threatImpacts.name: Account Access Removal
threatImpacts.description: Disabling accounts or removing access permissions to disrupt access to cloud resources

threatImpacts.name: Data Destruction
threatImpacts.description: Deliberate deletion, corruption, or overwriting of data, making it unavailable to authorized users

threatImpacts.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
threatImpacts.description: Encryption of data on cloud storage or databases to disrupt availability and demand ransom for decryption

threatImpacts.name: Defacement
threatImpacts.description: Modification of cloud-hosted content or resources to deface websites or applications, often to convey a message or cause reputational damage

threatImpacts.name: Email Bombing
threatImpacts.description: Sending large volumes of email to overwhelm email services or incur excessive costs through cloud email services

threatImpacts.name: Endpoint Denial of Service
threatImpacts.description: Actions that prevent authorized users from accessing cloud services or applications by overwhelming compute resources or disrupting normal operations

threatImpacts.name: Financial Theft
threatImpacts.description: Activities that directly lead to financial losses, such as excessive resource provisioning, fraudulent transactions, or cryptocurrency mining

threatImpacts.name: Inhibit System Recovery
threatImpacts.description: Deletion or disabling of backup and recovery capabilities to prevent restoration after destructive actions

threatImpacts.name: Network Denial of Service
threatImpacts.description: Network-level attacks that disrupt availability by saturating network bandwidth or overwhelming network infrastructure

threatImpacts.name: Resource Hijacking
threatImpacts.description: Taking control of cloud resources to repurpose them for unauthorized activities, such as cryptocurrency mining or hosting malicious content

threatImpacts.name: Service Stop
threatImpacts.description: Stopping or disabling cloud services to disrupt operations or as part of a destructive attack
